title: Data Restore: File Recovery
summary: Scan and restore recoverable photos, videos and audio on your device.
description:
Data Restore: File Recovery helps you find photos, videos, audio recordings and documents that remain accessible on your Android device. Scan supported storage locations, preview results, and restore selected items when possible.

Photo and Video Recovery
Find recoverable photos and videos, then preview them before restoring.

Audio Recovery
Scan for supported audio recordings and voice memos that are still available on your device.

Document Recovery
Look for supported PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets and other documents in accessible storage.

How it works
1. Grant the permissions required for scanning.
2. Start a scan of supported storage locations.
3. Preview the results.
4. Select items and restore them.

Privacy
Scanning and recovery are processed on your device. The app does not upload your files for recovery. Keep this statement only if it matches the app’s actual network behavior and privacy policy.

Root access is not required on supported devices. Results vary by Android version, storage type, permissions and whether new data has overwritten the original file.

Important
No app can guarantee recovery of every deleted file. This app can only find files that remain accessible to it. It does not bypass Android security or recover data from inaccessible or encrypted storage.

FAQ

Can every deleted file be recovered?
No. Recovery depends on your device and storage conditions. The scan shows which items are still available.

Where are restored files saved?
Restored files are saved to the destination shown in the app.
